name: Hitozuma Onsen ~Miwaku no Tabiji~
source:
The lead character Jun was raised without a mother's love since she was killed in a traffic accident when he was a primary school student. Jun, who is a university student now, happens to go to an overnight trip to a hot spring with his friends' mothers........
Exciting adventure game whose story takes place in a hot spring resort. 

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE022341.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公俊在小学时因车祸身亡，在没有母爱的情况下长大。现在已经是大学生的Jun，恰巧和朋友的妈妈一起去泡温泉过夜……
故事发生在温泉度假村的激动人心的冒险游戏。

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE022341.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
